niche: an environment ministry's 2027 Sulphur Dioxide Order, listing the permitted industrial coal boilers whose 2026 sulphur dioxide reached 250 tonnes, the inventory conformed from the coal suppliers' delivery analyses, the boiler operators' quarterly returns, the limestone quarries' delivery tickets, the annual scrubber performance tests and the permits' scrubber design data, where each wet limestone scrubber's real removal over the year is closed on the limestone it consumed
analyst_test: A strong analyst conforms each boiler's 2026 coal burned and its as-received sulphur from the suppliers' delivery analyses and the quarterly stock changes, takes off the permit's ash retention, applies the removal its scrubber showed at the 2026 performance test (or the permit's design removal) to the whole year and lists the boilers at or over 250 tonnes, filing one or two large boilers; it is wrong because several scrubbers stood bypassed for weeks while their boilers ran, which no return records and no announced test sees, and the limestone each scrubber consumed fixes the sulphur it actually removed.
domain_test: A sulphur dioxide inventory for abated combustion closes each unit's sulphur balance over the year (sulphur fired, less sulphur kept in the ash, less sulphur the absorber removed), and for a wet limestone scrubber the sulphur removed is set by the calcium carbonate it consumed at its operating stoichiometry, so the year's emissions come from the reagent balance, not from a removal rate observed while the absorber runs; with hospitals for boilers and infections for sulphur nothing stoichiometric binds a reagent to what it removes and the task stops making sense.
layer2_pattern: own:the year's sulphur removed read from the limestone each wet scrubber consumed at its guaranteed stoichiometry, closing the sulphur balance, against the scrubber's design removal or its announced annual test

driver: Each unit's period output of a pollutant is the content of what it burned less what its ash kept and less what its removal step took out, and the removal step's share over the period is read neither from its design nor from its one announced test, which see it only while it runs, but from the reagent it consumed, which it uses in a fixed ratio to what it removes; no record carries the hours the step stood idle while the unit ran, so only the reagent balance shows them.
driver_concrete: Each boiler's 2026 sulphur dioxide is the sulphur in the coal it burned, less the sulphur its ash kept, less the sulphur its wet limestone scrubber removed, and the sulphur removed is the limestone the scrubber consumed (deliveries less the quarter-end stock change, at each delivery's carbonate purity) over the vendor's guaranteed moles of calcium carbonate per mole of sulphur dioxide removed; scrubbers that stood bypassed for part of the year while their boilers ran consumed too little limestone for their design removal, and their sulphur dioxide runs three to six times what their design or their annual test implies.
stump: The default path takes each boiler's 2026 coal sulphur from the delivery analyses and the quarter-end stock changes, less the permit's ash retention, times one minus the removal its scrubber showed at the 2026 performance test, and lists only the largest boiler or two; the step that lands it there is carrying a removal observed while the scrubber ran across a year in which several scrubbers stood bypassed for weeks with their boilers firing, when the limestone each scrubber consumed, at its guaranteed stoichiometry, fixes the sulphur it removed and puts those boilers at three to six times their tested emissions, over the line.

differentiation.task477: There each industry's exposure to pay schedules is estimated from how its period totals move with the pay dates the periods hold; here nothing is estimated from co-movement: a conservation law on a consumed reagent fixes how much a removal step removed, and the period's output is the balance's remainder.
differentiation.task482: Its architecture 7 reads a removal device's share through the outlet floor it holds against a diluting inlet; here no model of the device is fitted at all, the reagent the device consumed bounds what it removed, and the shortfall is idle time no record carries.

lineage.fate: spent at stage 4, 2026-10-25: both scored readers fitted electors per dwelling to the dwelling's age since completion on the property-level registers and applied the ramp to every dwelling built and to come, landing the golden five
lineage.driver: A new unit's contribution to a register builds up over several annual rounds after the unit is created toward the level settled units hold, so a forecast that keeps each existing unit at its present count and adds the units still to come at the settled units' yield, or at the yield the newest units show today, misses both the recent units still building up and the units that will still be young at the horizon, while a uniform completeness factor moves nothing.
lineage.stump: The default path keeps each dwelling on the 1 December 2025 register at its 2025 count and adds the dwellings since and the trajectory's at the settled stock's electors per dwelling by type, filing Ebborby, Kettermere, Lorrimere North and Tibberfield; the estates completed from 2024 in Lorrimere West, Caldenstow Park and Quenbrook are still joining the register and the North Lorrimere and Tibberfield sites completing from 2030 will still be young in 2032, so aged to their canvasses five wards fail: Lorrimere West, Caldenstow Park, Quenbrook, Ebborby and Kettermere.
lineage.niche: a boundary commission's electoral review of a district's 23 wards, each ward's electors on the register to be published after the 2032 canvass forecast from six canvasses of the register at property level, the address register and the council's housing trajectory, where a new dwelling's electors join the register over several canvasses after it is completed

lineage.fate: spent at stage 4 round 1, 2026-10-25: both scored readers rebuilt each animal's days from the movement register at the factor note's per-day rates by region and housing season and landed the golden six
lineage.driver: A region's period total of a flow is read as each unit's annual rate for that region times the units counted there on one day, but part of the units move between regions with the seasons and their rate is several times higher in the season they spend in their other region; the total belongs to each region by the days each unit spends there in each season, rebuilt from the units' movement histories, and an average of the units present still leaves each unit's high-rate season with the region where it spends the low-rate one.
lineage.stump: The default path multiplies each region's 1 June 2026 census by the factor note's annual factor per head and divides by farmed land, designating nine regions: it adds Lake Uplands, Middle Uplands, Eastern Uplands, Western Seaboard and Atlantic Coast, whose June herds hold lowland yearlings out on summer grazing lets and calves bought from dairy farms that spring, and it misses Inner Basin and Lower Basin, whose finishers house stores all winter and send them to slaughter before June; averaging the bovine register's count over the year still adds Lake Uplands, Middle Uplands and Western Seaboard, because the annual factor's housed days never happen there.
lineage.niche: a national ammonia programme's 2027 Ammonia Action Regions, designated on each region's cattle-manure ammonia per hectare of farmed land over the 2025-26 programme year, conformed from the bovine register's animal and movement records, the June livestock census, the herd register, the land parcel register and the inventory's factors, where youngstock spend the summer on grazing lets and the winter housed in another region
